findings.quote: The graded fix changed `S3` to 3 and matched all 261 reference samples.

Both `S2` and `S3` were encoded as 2, so entering the `S3` encoding still selected the earlier `S2` case arm. The FSM could never take the transition from `S3` to `S4` that asserts `flag`. The graded fix changed `S3` to 3 and matched all 261 reference samples.
